Class ReportsView

java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node
javafx.scene.Parent

manager.ReportsView
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class ReportsView extends javafx.scene.layout.VBox
A manager-facing report page. Reports are selected from SideBarMgr.

      private void loadDefaultProductUsage(javafx.scene.control.DatePicker start, javafx.scene.control.DatePicker end, javafx.scene.layout.VBox chartRows)
      Sets the date pickers to the 30 days ending on the most recent order and loads product usage for that window. Uses today's date if no orders are found.
      Parameters:
      start - the "From" date picker to fill in
      end - the "Through" date picker to fill in
      chartRows - the chart to draw the results in

    • savePdf

      private void savePdf()
      Prompts for a PDF destination and snapshots the displayed columns, rows, and loaded report description before saving on a background thread. Cancelling leaves the report unchanged; an existing file is confirmed when the PDF extension is appended. Export stays disabled while saving, and completion messages are shown only if the same report load is still displayed.

    • loadStandardReport

      private void loadStandardReport(ReportsView.ReportDefinition definition, LocalDate start, LocalDate end)
      Runs a report's query on a background thread. Also, shows the results. The dates are used for Sales by Item.
      Parameters:
      definition - the report to run
      start - the first day to include (Sales by Item only)
      end - the last day to include (Sales by Item only)

    • showStandardReport

      private void showStandardReport(long request, List<String> columnNames, List<List<String>> rows, ReportsView.ReportDefinition definition, LocalDate start, LocalDate end)
      Makes one table column per query column and fills in the rows. Nothing is done if a newer load has started since this one.
      Parameters:
      request - the load number from when this load started
      columnNames - the column names from the query
      rows - the formatted cell values for each row
